item.content:encoded:
this is just taking two pre-existing characters and throwing them at a wall, hoping they stick together

I mean, Sophia Light actually did have a fiance that died from a traumatic, not-very-described accident. I'm not quite sure how I can fix having a story about love and loss if it doesn't involve characters coming together or splitting apart. I'm sorry, I don't think I can fix that.

I'll try to make my prose less purple next time, thanks. :)
